fantasy-summer.notes: Distinct rubble pile, broken columns, small arch, low wall, tower stump, large broken arch, overgrown foundation and stair-front doorway. The large arch and stair-front doorway share a motif but their silhouettes and footprints are different enough at 1x; they are not near-duplicates. Muted warm stone/moss fits the approved fantasy markers and ground details. Top-left highlights and lower/right shadows are consistent. No modern-collapse requirement applies to fantasy: its columns and arches are allowed.
